title: Ric Flair - 'Can We Just Wake Up Tomorrow & Let Ric Flair Be Ric Flair?' - NewsBreak
text:
By Ryan Clark ,
58 minutes ago
WWE Hall of Famer Ric Flair is looking to put recent controversy behind him, offering an apology and calling for a more positive tone after his comments about Ludwig Kaiser and WWE sparked backlash.
The situation unfolded after Flair appeared on “The Ariel Helwani Show,” where he expressed frustration with WWE and claimed he felt disrespected. He said he was not invited to WrestleMania 42, which he linked to a past issue involving Kaiser in 2025.
Flair explained that tensions began during a storyline involving his daughter, Charlotte Flair, and Tiffany Stratton, who was reportedly dating Kaiser at the time. According to Flair, Stratton made indirect remarks about Charlotte’s past marriage, which escalated the situation. He admitted that he later contacted Kaiser and made threats, believing that incident may have strained his relationship with WWE.

During the podcast, Flair also criticized WWE, claiming there is “too much politics” behind the scenes. He voiced disappointment about missing WrestleMania-related events, including Stephanie McMahon’s Hall of Fame induction, and said he felt overlooked given his legacy in the business.
However, Flair has since softened his stance. In a post on Twitter, he issued an apology to Kaiser, clarifying that he never intended to question his in-ring ability. He acknowledged that his earlier comments were emotional, driven by his protective nature toward his family, and noted that he has heard positive feedback about Kaiser’s work.
In a follow-up message, Flair reiterated his apology and urged fans to show more respect online. Addressing the criticism he received, he called for less negativity on social media, adding that at this stage in his life, he is focused on peace and positivity. He wrote,
“I Have Apologized, And I Have Retracted Statements. I Have Made Assumptions That Are Incorrect. I Acknowledge Everything That I Have Said. Can We Just Wake Up Tomorrow & Let Ric Flair Be Ric Flair. I Am 77 With A Heart Condition And Nothing Is Ever Guaranteed. Let’s Just All Be At Peace! If You Look At Social Media, People Love To Attack Every Celebrity Online Without Using Their Real Name. I’m Ric Flair. Take Me For Who I Am. The People Who Know Me Know How Hard I’ve Worked My Entire Life To Achieve My Level Of Success. That Is Not Up For Debate. Thank You For Everything! Please Let Me Wake Up Tomorrow And Have My Social Media Screen Be Only Positives. I’m Always Going To Be A Cowboy! W !”
